name: Passage
source:
As a recent college graduate, you are desperately looking for a job in your field. After several rejections and constant nightmares about your experiences, you find hope. 

Your roommate, a beloved pet cat, transforms into an ancient Egyptian god to assist you! With his powers, you can learn everything you need to know about nabbing your dream job.  He can stop time, allowing you to think before making your choices! 

Navigate standard interview questions and weird brain teasers in intense scenes. Discover the truth behind your nightmares and unveil the dark secrets kept by employers everywhere! Will you nail the interview process and impress your future employer? Or will you fall into a void of darkness? An interview can mean life or death these days.

[From [url=https://emcatgames.itch.io/passage]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
作为一名刚毕业的大学生，你急切地在自己的专业领域寻找工作。经历多次拒绝，并不断被过往经历带来的噩梦困扰后，你终于看到希望。

你的室友——一只惹人喜爱的宠物猫——变成了古埃及神明来帮助你！借助他的力量，你可以学会求职成功所需的一切。他还能让时间暂停，让你在做出选择前仔细思考！

在紧张的面试环节中应对常见问题和古怪的脑筋急转弯。揭开噩梦背后的真相，发现各地雇主隐藏的黑暗秘密！你能顺利通过面试，打动未来的雇主吗？还是会坠入黑暗深渊？如今，一场面试也可能决定生死。

[来源：[url=https://emcatgames.itch.io/passage]Itch.io[/url]]
